findings.title: Migration fails when no embed category is configured
findings.body: This query can return no rows when `embed_category` is blank or does not match a category, which is a normal state for installations that have not configured a category. Indexing `[0]['id']` then raises before the migration reaches its fallback to the uncategorized category, preventing the upgrade from completing. Handle the empty result before reading the ID.

findings.title: Allowed hosts configured with a port never match
findings.body: The host validator accepts entries with ports, but `record_for_host` compares the stored value against `uri.host`, which omits the port. A configured entry such as `example.com:8080` therefore cannot authorize a referer on that port, so embedding is rejected despite the host being accepted and saved. Compare the relevant port as well, or reject ports during validation.
